requirements.statement: The core command registry exposes only unique, stable, implemented command contracts.
CLI dispatch renders discovery and returns non-success for unsupported commands.
The native process implements version and help entrypoints with stable failure semantics.

The native fortress audit command accepts an optional repository root, renders deterministic human or schema-versioned JSON output, succeeds only for governed evaluation without violations, reports missing or invalid project authority as non-success after supported observation, and rejects unsupported options.

The native fortress ccg command compiles the canonical repository semantic IR once, renders deterministic canonical JSON, returns non-success for incoherency or invalid state, and rejects unsupported formats without implying certification.

The native fortress bfg command compiles Intended BFG v1 from the repository CCG, emits canonical deterministic JSON to standard output or an explicit file, returns non-success for incoherent modeled flow or invalid state, and never implies behavior realization or certification.

The native fortress psm command compiles snapshot-bound Program Semantic Model v3, emits canonical deterministic JSON to standard output or an explicit file, returns non-success for invalid or analyzer-incoherent state, and never implies behavioral realization or certification.

The native fortress semantic command compiles PSM-backed Function Contract and abstract-domain analysis, emits deterministic canonical JSON to standard output or an explicit file, fails on supported contradictions or invalid state, and preserves uncertainty without implying total program safety or certification.

The native fortress state-effect command compiles PSM- and Semantic-Analysis-backed typestate and effect analysis, emits deterministic canonical JSON to standard output or a file, fails on supported contradictions or invalid authority, and preserves uncertainty without implying total program safety or certification.

The native fortress information-flow command compiles one PSM-, Semantic-, and State/Effect-backed information-flow model, emits deterministic canonical JSON to standard output or a file, fails on supported sink contradictions or invalid authority, and preserves security uncertainty without implying comprehensive security proof or certification.

The native fortress environmental command compiles one PSM-, value-, state/effect-, and information-flow-backed environmental model, emits deterministic canonical JSON to standard output or a file, fails on supported environment/retry/recovery contradictions or invalid authority, and preserves uncertainty without implying comprehensive fault-tolerance proof or certification.

The native fortress realized-bfg command compiles one Intended-BFG- and implementation-semantics-backed Realized BFG, emits deterministic canonical JSON to standard output or a file, fails on supported realization or bypass contradictions or invalid authority, and preserves coverage uncertainty without implying runtime trace evidence or certification.

The native fortress certify command brackets and executes the exact unfiltered Rust workspace/all-target/all-feature suite with an absolute build target outside the governed repository, rejects source mutation, compiles each semantic model once, and emits deterministic Evidence Graph, Certification, and Verified BFG products without remote evidence or signatures.

The native fortress references command renders the deterministic CCG-bound component resolution projection or a non-mutating stable-identity relocation preview and rejects incomplete or invalid move requests without changing repository files.
